usageNotes: Use this to update the contact email address(es) registered with the ACME CA for an existing account, or to force a refresh of the account record from the CA without changing anything (omit the `contact` param). Requires that an ACME account already exists under the given config name; create one first with the corresponding POST endpoint if it does not. Returns a task UPID — poll the task status endpoint to confirm completion.

examples.summary: Update the contact email on the default ACME account

tips: Calling this endpoint with no body (or an empty body) acts as a CA refresh — useful to resync account status after CA-side changes without modifying local config.
The `name` path param defaults to 'default', so omitting it targets the default ACME account.
The returned string is a UPID; use get_nodes_node_tasks_upid_status to track completion.
Multiple contact addresses can be supplied as a comma-separated email list in the `contact` field.
